0.0: Brake off. The lever is now completely free, so hold it. Slide it slowly each way, over and over, until the countdown ends.
1.0: Brake at 1.0. Pull slowly until it slips, slide a little, ease off. Repeat until the countdown ends.
2.0: Brake at 2.0. Pull slowly until it slips, slide a little, ease off. Repeat until the countdown ends.
